<!-- Do not include game files, EBOOTs, ISOs, firmware, keys or screenshots of copyrighted game content. Logs only, with user names and folder paths removed. -->

## Why

What problem this solves, in one or two sentences. Link the issue if there is one.

## Change

What the pull request changes, file group by file group.

## Tests

The exact commands you ran and their result (for example `python3 tools/ci/repo_checks.py`). For changes that touch the game: the build or commit, Windows version, GPU and driver.

## Evidence

Log excerpts or output that show the change works. Say what you could not run.

## Overlap

Open pull requests or issues that touch the same files, or "none" after checking `gh pr list`.
